evidence: From the car park at the end of Mt Richmond Road, the track follows Te Hoiere/Pelorus River for an hour to Emerald Pool, an ideal fishing, swimming and picnicking spot.
From Red Hills Hut, the Te Araroa Track continues to climb Maitland Ridge for 7.9km to Beebys Knob Road.
Then the Beebys Knob Road descends for 3.7km to meet Tophouse Road near the Lowther Road turnoff.

doubts: The end is where Beebys Knob Road meets Tophouse Road near the Lowther Road turnoff, which no feature or name entry matches, so the end ref is null. The start is taken as F4, the road end where the Pelorus Track meets Mount Richmond Road, because the text's car park is at the end of Mt Richmond Road; the feature names the Pelorus Track, so this is a judgment. The description is cut off in the packet after the Red Hills Hut to Tophouse Road section, so anything after that is not in the text. The Wairoa crossings (eight, Mid Wairoa to Top Wairoa) are not said to be unbridged, so no how is given. Time 8 days is DOC's summary; no distance for the whole way. The exit options (Tarn Hut to Goulter road end, Mid Wairoa Hut to Wairoa Road end) and the Hacket Track alternative entrance each have their own heading and time, so they are recorded as separate ways below.
